gemini.data_terms: free tier: Google may use inputs and outputs to improve its products and human reviewers may read them (accepted by the team, Phase 7 Amendment 1)
gemini.model_choice: gemini-3.5-flash: fixed version, not a preview or 'latest' alias. Smoke test 2026-11-23: gemini-3.8-flash returned 503 twice; gemini-3.5-flash answered all five fields correctly. Later the same day gemini-3.5-flash returned 503 'high demand' (temporary, per Google) while gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-2.5-flash answered correctly. Kept gemini-3.5-flash: the SDK retries 503 with backoff and the run resumes from the cache; it can still be changed before the prompt is frozen, never during a run. Dev round 1 (prompt v1, 2026-11-23): gemini-3.5-flash finished 14 of 100 items (86 failed with 503 'high demand' or timeouts; median latency 31 s), so the model was switched to gemini-2.5-flash (answered correctly in the smoke test) before any freeze. Dev round 2: gemini-2.5-flash allows only 20 free requests per day (429, quota metric generate_content_free_tier_requests), so the model was switched to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (same family, answered correctly in the smoke test) before any freeze.
